## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle structural-outline (*kē* 科) of **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shí píní yìchāo* 四分律拾毗尼義鈔 ([KR6k0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0176)) by **Yuánzhào** 元照 ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116). Author signature: *餘杭靈芝蘭若　元照　錄* (*Recorded by Yuánzhào, of the Língzhī monastery in Yúháng*).

**Abstract**

The *Kē* serves as the structural index for the parent text [KR6k0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0176) *Sìfēnlǜ shí píní yìchāo* in Yuánzhào's *jiàokān* 校勘 (collated) recension. Yuánzhào's preface to the *Yìchāo* (preserved at [KR6k0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0176) No. 747-A) is here divided structurally; the two works together constitute a coherent late-eleventh-century *Língzhīsì* 靈芝寺 editorial project to recover and structurally analyse Dàoxuān's lesser-known Vinaya digest. Composition belongs to Yuánzhào's mature period (post-1075).
